notes.title: Crystal Tales Tactics: Take a look at this upcoming project
notes.content:
Hey there! 
Do you already know about our upcoming release from Male Doll Everyone series?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/?l=portuguese]Crystal Tales Tactics[/url] is a stunning fantasy RPG without gender limitations in the relationship system, you can date whoever you want! There are also multiple strategic mechanics and a total of 15 different characters, including one protagonist for which you choose the gender and 14 other characters available for relationship. Each character has a unique personality and a charming appearance that can make you fall in love!
To give you a closer look at this exciting project we will be hosting a live stream on Steam at May 30th, where we'll explore the new demo and showcase the game's updates so far. If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542710/Dreams_of_an_Exile/#:~:text=Dreams%20of%20an%20Exile%20on%20Steam&text=Dreams%20of%20an%20Exile%20is,a%20cute%20pixel%20art%20style.]Dreams of an Exile[/url], it's worth taking a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/?l=portuguese]Crystal Tales[/url]. You can also play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191100/Crimson_Song__Yuri_Visual_Novel/]Crimson Song[/url], which has just been released!
Join us on May 30th for the live stream and wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/?l=portuguese]Crystal Tales Tactics[/url] on Steam! There's also a demo available in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/?l=portuguese]game page[/url] if you'd like to give it a try.

notes.title: Crimson Song: Our newest yuri novel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39923743/ced9fe45e5b534f705b93b960b5cdf071d823ed0.png[/img]


Hey there! 
For those who enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542710/Dreams_of_an_Exile/]Dreams of an Exile[/url], take a look at our newly released game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191100/Crimson_Song__Yuri_Visual_Novel/]Crimson Song[/url]!
It's a yuri novel with a dark atmosphere, following the story of Diandrir and the mysterious girl she encounters along her path. 
It's 10% OFF during the launch week and we're sure you'll enjoy it too! 
This game is also part of the Malle Doll Everyone series. Thank you for the support and stay tuned for more upcoming releases.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191100/Crimson_Song__Yuri_Visual_Novel/

notes.title: [Patch v1.0.4a] Dreams of an Exile v1.0.4a is now available
notes.content:
We’ve received feedback about a possible way to break Dreams of an Exile girls’ routes, so we’ve made a small patch to fix it. Thank [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1542710/discussions/0/3113646913582036638/]Tuuo[/url] for reporting it!

Now, it’s not possible to access a specific area before the right moment for it. This will make you avoid the problem in which you can’t trigger one of Nessire’s cutscene.

Thank you all for using the game forum and Discord to report bugs and we hope you also enjoy our next yuri games. 

Have you wishlisted Magic Exposure? If not, do it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/Magic_Exposure__Yuri_Visual_Novel/

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url], we’re getting closer to 600 followers!

Male Doll Team
